blocks.text: A reducer can be tested without opening the page. Give it a known state and action, then compare the result.

Use an Angular project with the matching major version of @ngrx/store. Effects and SignalStore examples also need @ngrx/effects or @ngrx/signals. Save linked snippets in the files named by their imports.

blocks.title: Test a state rule directly

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `createAction` defines an NgRx event creator. Calling the creator makes an action object to dispatch.
`createReducer` matches actions to state update rules. In NgRx, return new state instead of mutating the old object.

blocks.text: Both checks pass: the result resets while the original state stays unchanged.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Test behaviour and original-state safety. Merely checking that a reducer function exists tells little.
